title: Knowlify vs MakeUGC: Done-for-You AI Ads or a Self-Serve Tool?
summary: Knowlify vs MakeUGC for AI UGC ads: a done-for-you team with human checks or MakeUGC's self-serve credits. Compare credit math, retries and staff time.
body_markdown:
## Which other AI UGC tools and agencies belong on the list?


Credit systems are hard to compare directly.[Arcads](https://help.arcads.ai/en/articles/13725589-how-are-credits-counted) charges talking-actor generation at 800 credits per rounded-up minute per actor, plus 80 credits for captions and 240 for translation, and its video-generation models have their own rates. A 500-credit allowance in one system is not the same output as 500 credits in another. Run the same script and product task through every tool on this list before judging output. Our[MakeUGC alternatives guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/makeugc-alternatives) covers more options.


[AdCreative.ai](https://www.adcreative.ai/) has a UGC video page where you upload a product photo, choose an AI avatar and add a script, in talking-head, show-and-tell and fashion formats. It is software, so your team generates, chooses and downloads the creatives.


[Admiral Media](https://admiral.media/ai-ugc-agency/) sells AI presenter ads with human editing and quality review. Its published tiers are €10,000 for 20 ads of up to 15 seconds, €16,000 for 40 ads of up to 30 seconds and €29,000 for 80 ads of up to 60 seconds. The page says its ideal clients invest US$50,000 or more a month in paid media, so check that your budget fits before you request a proposal. Compare its scope, revisions and rights with a Knowlify quote for the same ad count.


## What Meta rules apply to AI talking-actor ads?


Meta's[Reels ads page](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads/facebook-instagram-reels-ads) recommends 9:16 video with audio, with key messages kept inside the safe zone, clear of the Reels interface. It also says Reels play with sound on unless the viewer turns sound off, so add captions anyway. Build the master at 9:16 and export a 4:5 version for Feed, following Meta's[aspect ratio guidance](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/103816146375741) .


Meta's[AI transparency update](https://about.fb.com/news/2025/02/gen-ai-transparency-metas-ads-products/) says it labels ads created or significantly edited with its own generative AI creative features, and a photorealistic AI-generated person gets the label next to the Sponsored label. It also says it will begin detecting ads made with third-party AI tools and show an "AI info" label, though the post does not say that detection is live yet. Regional rules differ, so check them before you publish.


Responsibility for accuracy sits with the advertiser. Meta's[Ad Creative Generative AI Terms](https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms/ad_creative_generative_ai_terms) make the advertiser solely responsible for checking the accuracy of output from Meta's tools, and the same discipline applies to any AI tool you use. Generated video can show a product that does not exist, garbled lettering or wrong hands, so someone must review each variant before it ships.


Test each tool the same way. Run one script and one product task through each route, then count the staff hours it took to reach an approved ad, not only the credits spent.


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick when you want finished AI UGC ads made and checked for you, with about 25 finished ads a week and optional Meta campaign management.
- MakeUGC fits a team that will generate, edit and approve talking-actor ads itself on a self-serve plan.
- At 100 credits per generation, the 500-credit Starter covers five generations before retries, so budget for the retries you expect.
- Meta's AI labels and the advertiser's accuracy responsibility apply whichever route you choose.
- Compare a Knowlify quote for the same ad count with the staff hours your team would spend on MakeUGC.


## FAQ


### What is the best option for AI UGC ads?


Knowlify is our top pick for teams that want finished AI UGC ads made and checked for them, with optional Meta campaign management. MakeUGC is a reasonable choice when your team wants a self-serve tool and will run every generation, edit and approval. Decide which of those two jobs your team can actually staff.


### Does MakeUGC offer a managed service?


It advertises a managed Enterprise option, so ask what that covers before you assume it matches Knowlify's scope. Knowlify offers creative production with optional Meta management, or creative only. Ask both to put production steps, revision rounds and approval responsibilities in writing.


### Is the $29 plan the real price?


It is the annual-billing equivalent, not the month-to-month price. Starter costs $59 a month when billed monthly. Confirm the billing period and usage tier before you buy, since the plan table changes export resolution, parallel jobs and custom avatars by tier.


### How does Knowlify's price compare?


Knowlify's plans start at $5,000 a month, so compare that fee with MakeUGC's credits only on the same deliverable. Ask for a quote on the same number of finished, approved ads, then add the staff hours your team would spend generating and editing on the MakeUGC side. Do not compare a credit cost with a finished-ad price without that step.


### Can I present an AI presenter as a real customer?


No. An AI presenter has no experience of your product, so it should never claim to have used it or pose as a customer. Meta's[AI transparency update](https://about.fb.com/news/2025/02/gen-ai-transparency-metas-ads-products/) also says it labels ads created or significantly edited with its own generative AI features. A testimonial from a real customer needs a real person, which means a different production route.
